Name: Asahiah, Servant of Josiah
Summary: Asahiah, a servant of King Josiah, was one of the messengers sent to inquire of Huldah concerning the found book.
KeyStory: Asahiah sent to inquire of Huldah.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Hilkiah, High Priest; Huldah, Prophetess
LifeLesson: Even a king's servant was sent to hear God's word firsthand.
